title: messages.jsonl line
description: One message the person wrote (table messages with its revisions, docs/spec/20-privacy.md section 5.2), in every channel and direct message, deleted ones as tombstones without content. Never a message of another person. Channel name and thread title only while the person may still read the channel; otherwise only the IDs.

thread_id.description: ID of the thread of the message.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel of the message (a direct message is a channel, too).

channel_name.description: Name of the channel; absent for a direct message and when the person may no longer read the channel.

thread_title.description: Title of the thread; absent when the thread has none and when the person may no longer read the channel.

content_md.description: The Markdown text of the message as it is now; empty for a deleted message.

edited_at.description: When the message was last edited; absent when never edited.

deleted.description: Whether the message is deleted (a tombstone without content).

deleted_at.description: When the message was deleted; absent for a message that is not deleted.

revisions.description: The earlier versions of the message the person edited, oldest first; empty when never edited or deleted.

revision.description: Number of the revision; 1 is the original text.

content_md.description: The Markdown text before the edit.

created_at.description: When the edit that replaced this text was made.

attachment_file_ids.description: IDs of the files attached to the message, in their order; the files themselves are under files/. Absent without attachments.
